description.value:
The iron bucket contains all sorts of Belobog delicacies as a stew, and is simmered thoroughly using low heat.
Ingredients with outlandish appearances float in the soup, but it smells very delicious.

"What's wrong if they were once specimens? Aren't they dead animals and plants anyways?"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Affected creatures have resistance to fire damage and gain temporary hit points equal to their level plus their proficiency bonus. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, decreases Fire DMG taken by all allies by 16% and increases Max HP of all allies by 20% for the next battle.
